# Release Notes

Add one Markdown file per release tag, for example `v1.1.4.md`.

Release notes should be short, user-facing bullet points about GitOK itself. Include visible app behavior, UI changes, feature changes, update-check changes, packaging changes, and user-relevant bug fixes.

Do not include development-only work such as CI fixes, release workflow changes, dependency/tooling updates, refactors, typecheck/lint changes, or repository maintenance.

Example:

```md
- Added update checking from the settings window.
- Improved repository cards so the folder shortcut is easier to discover.
- Fixed the app version display in the update prompt.
```
